comment: Starting points for the checks a repository declares for its design decisions (catalog items routed 'decision'). Copy a rule into design/checks/<name>.yaml, change the selectors and values to the decision written in DESIGN.md, and cite it from the item as rule:<id>. 'for' names the catalog heading path each example was written for. Prefer count/text/style; use judgment only when the decision cannot be stated as selectors, text or computed style.

for.dialog-not-for-links: components/modal-dialog > 注意が必要なケース
for.accordion-single-heading: components/accordion > コンポーネント要素
for.focus-ring-color: foundations/color > 機能カラー > フォーカスカラー
for.primary-button-radius: foundations/corner-shapes > 角の形状の違いによる強調表現

rules.statement: Cards group one item's summary and a single link to its details; they never hold forms or long text.
